# Known CI flakes, read by scripts/ci-wait. A failed job counts as a known
# flake when every failing test it reports matches a test pattern below (and
# ExUnit counted no failure the log does not show, and the suite did not
# abort), or, for a job that died without reporting a failing test, when its
# whole log matches a log: pattern.
#
# Format: `<name> <pattern>`, one per line. The name has no spaces; the
# pattern is the rest of the line, an extended regex (grep -E) matched
# against one failing test's report: its title line and what follows.
# `<name> log:<pattern>` is matched against the whole log instead, only
# when no failing test was reported; keep those to signatures that never
# appear in a passing log, since unrelated noise lines join up in a whole
# log. Before matching, timestamps, `##[error]` prefixes and colour codes are
# stripped and the lines are joined with spaces, so `.*` can span lines.
#
# Comment every entry: what it is and why it is not the change's fault.
# Mark entries waiting on a fix TEMPORARY and remove them when it lands.
# Flaky means broken (CODING_STANDARDS.md): an entry here is a stopgap that
# saves a CI round, not a reason to stop looking for the cause.

# The Erlang JIT crashing on the runner: mix test aborts with exit 134 after
# an asmjit assertion in jitallocator.cpp, unrelated to the code under test.
# Only ever seen on the OTP 28.0 leg (mix test (OTP 28 | Elixir 1.19.5)).
# TEMPORARY (10 Oct 2026): expected fixed by moving the 1.19 leg off OTP 28.0;
# remove after two weeks without a hit.
beam-jit-crash log:\[asmjit\] Assertion failed at asmjit/core/jitallocator\.cpp.*exit code 134

# The Hex registry timing out during `mix deps.get`: Hex falls back to its
# cache, finds no record for a locked package and stops with "Unknown
# package <name> in lockfile" before any code is compiled. Seen on #3219
# (17 Oct 2026, polymorphic_embed); a rerun passes.
hex-registry-timeout log:Failed to fetch record for [A-Za-z0-9_]+ from registry \(using cache instead\) :timeout .*\*\* \(Mix\) Unknown package [A-Za-z0-9_]+ in lockfile

# AssistantLiveTest's text block proposal: the page shows the model's final
# reply but not the proposal's "Ready for your review" (CI 19, 26 and 27 Oct
# 2026, both OTP legs). Checked without finding the cause: the run broadcasts
# `{:proposal, id}` from the same process before the reply, after the
# conversation's proposal_id is committed; the view subscribes before the run
# starts and reloads the conversation on the event; the cassette's tool result
# has no problems; no preview opens; 160 local runs alone and 31 of the whole
# module on one scheduler showed it never (one run, under load, timed out
# waiting for the reply instead). CI cuts the page short, so the assertion
# now prints the view's proposal, error and run.
# TEMPORARY (27 Oct 2026): remove once a failure's message names the cause.
assistant-text-block-proposal a message produces a reviewed proposal that one click applies \(BrandoAdmin\.AssistantLiveTest\).*Ready for your review
